name: Monitor YouTube channels for new uploads, summarize transcripts with AI & send to Slack + Sheets

parameters.content:
## Automated YouTube Channel Monitor -> AI Brief -> Slack & Google Sheets

### How it works
Turn any public YouTube channel into an automated competitor or research intelligence feed without running polling scripts or maintaining proxies.

1. **Receive & verify webhook:** Catches signed `transcript.ready` events from YT to Text Channel Monitor, validates the `X-YTToText-Signature` (`v1=<hex>`) HMAC-SHA256 signature and 5-minute replay window, and rejects invalid callers with `401`.
2. **Prepare & summarize:** Cleans transcript text, computes word count and reading time, safely caps context at 24,000 characters, and generates a structured JSON research brief with OpenAI.
3. **Deliver & archive:** Posts the formatted digest to Slack, logs the structured record to Google Sheets, and returns `200 OK` to acknowledge webhook delivery.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Create a Channel Watchlist and copy your `whsec_...` webhook secret at [yttotext.com/watchlists](https://yttotext.com/watchlists).
- [ ] Set `YTTOTEXT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in n8n Environment Variables (or replace the placeholder in **Verify HMAC-SHA256 Signature**).
- [ ] Connect your **OpenAI**, **Slack**, and **Google Sheets** credentials and pick your target channel and spreadsheet.
- [ ] Activate the workflow and copy the Production Webhook URL into your YT to Text watchlist.

### Customization
- Swap **Google Sheets** for Notion, Airtable, or Supabase Vector Store to build a searchable team knowledge base.
- Adjust the summary prompt in **Summarize Transcript (OpenAI)** to extract pricing mentions, feature launches, or product quotes.

Docs: [yttotext.com/youtube-channel-monitor](https://yttotext.com/youtube-channel-monitor)

## 1. Receive & verify signed webhook

Accepts `POST` events from YT to Text Watchlists, validates HMAC-SHA256 signature + 5-minute timestamp window, and returns `401` on tampered requests.

## 2. Prepare transcript & generate AI research brief

Normalizes transcript text, calculates length metrics, caps token budget, and asks OpenAI for a structured summary, key takeaways, and notable quotes.

## 3. Publish digest & acknowledge delivery

Posts the research brief to Slack, appends a searchable row to Google Sheets, and acknowledges the webhook with `200 OK`.

### Required before activating
1. Set your `YTTOTEXT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (`whsec_...`) from [yttotext.com/watchlists](https://yttotext.com/watchlists) inside **Verify HMAC-SHA256 Signature**.
2. Replace placeholder Slack channel ID and Google Sheet ID before turning the workflow **Active**.

values.content: You are a concise research analyst. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: oneLineSummary (string), keyTakeaways (array of 3-5 concise bullets), notableQuotes (array of 1-2 short verbatim quotes), actionItems (array of 1-3 follow-up actions).
